ca57de825be11a.x: PM Surya Ghar was launched in 2024; 2021 is the year of the Panchamrit goals at COP26.

Second-generation feedstocks include rice/wheat straw, bagasse and bamboo

Department of Atomic Energy – Established in 1954, Mumbai, under the Prime Minister

n879b67467e9.x: The incentive under the Accelerated Breed Improvement Programme is up to 50% of the cost on assured pregnancy, not 25%.

All States and UTs are eligible

e-KCC sanction takes about three days

ca7317da03f031.x: Mid-sized States get parks of 100–500 acres; up to 1,000 acres applies to areas near cities.

E100 is a blend containing 20% ethanol

ca0f59d623d662.s: India's mobile phone production in 2025–26 was approximately:

ca04b652b8b523.s: The Ground Level Credit target for FY 2025–26 was:

ncfc402a9aa9.x: They were approved at the 56th GST Council meeting and took effect in September 2025.

ca2a7f16485f3f.s: The revised Consumer Price Index (CPI), used by the MPC, has its base year as:
ca2a7f16485f3f.x: The revised CPI has 2024 as its base year and is used by the MPC.

caed2c27f1aee8.x: The ADB loan of USD 230 million is for water and sanitation in Chennai.

ca9b6368e9c6e1.x: Article 279A provides for the GST Council; 246A gives GST law-making power and 269A covers inter-State supplies.

ca339b04662f14.x: The Constitution (101st Amendment) Act, 2016 enabled GST; 122nd was the number of the Bill introduced in 2014.

ne5a84265849.x: The 5F Vision runs Farm → Fibre → Factory → Fashion → Foreign.

n553fefa0b95.x: The Atomic Energy Act 1962 replaced the 1948 Act.

ca99181567cbb2.x: India is fourth globally in meat, second in eggs and the largest producer of milk.

ca6f5255d669a9.x: Solar capacity grew from about 3 GW in 2014 to 162.15 GW, including 118.79 GW from large projects.

n970db2ffb72.x: Wind capacity was 58.14 GW; 164.59 GW is the solar capacity.

cacb6d61389e35.s: The National Mission on Natural Farming was approved as a standalone Centrally Sponsored Scheme on:
cacb6d61389e35.x: The Mission was approved on 25 November 2024.

caa03763d1578c.x: Coconut is Cocos nucifera of the family Arecaceae.
